en.html:
Iwata"Beyond this point, the guard has no gaps. Slipping past will be difficult."
Kageaki"Understood. The remaining route?"
Iwata"The stairs at the end: go two floors up. Not the top floor, please note."
Iwata"Then straight along the corridor, turn at the third branch, and your destination is at the end."
Kageaki"............ An inconvenient quantity of distance."

Ichijou"Oi, spy. From here, which way is that room?"
Iwata"The direction? Probably... almost directly above us."
Ichijou"Minato sir. Let us just smash through."
Kageaki"..."
Iwata"..."
Kageaki"Ah. That option was also there."
Iwata"Y-you are serious?"
Kageaki"Entirely rational. Shortest distance, and a very conspicuous disturbance. Both our requirements are being met."
Iwata"...Haa. Well, if you have decided, I shall not stop you."
Kageaki"From here the work is ours. Please make your way back."
Iwata"Understood..."
Ichijou"Come then, Minato sir. We can armour here, no?"
Kageaki"————"
Ichijou"Minato sir?"
Iwata"............"
Ichijou"...? Oi, how long are you planning to stand there?"
Ichijou"Bhaago, na! Get out of—"
Kageaki"Ichijou! Back to the corridor!"
Ichijou"!?"

en.html:
Late. Far, far too late.

Around us: warriors. More warriors. Still more warriors.

Misshapen dragoons in a complete ring. Forget escaping upright; even to crawl out, there was no gap.

en.html:
Doushin"To make his move now—such honesty! For plotting and scheming, the fellow has no aptitude..."
Kageaki"..."
Doushin"Once I knew who stood behind you, what you would do was not difficult. His Highness Kuniuji, naturally. The sensible target, no?"
Doushin"Attack His Highness, give him even one scratch, and my standing among the shogunate's ministers is finished. Last night's little sermon, Shishiku will not make too much fuss about. But an injury to His Highness... arre, that is another matter."
Kageaki"..."
Doushin"So, if His Highness is the target, when to come? When everybody has relaxed, of course. Just after some big function, perhaps?"
Doushin"Bas, there you have it! So grandly I have explained, and what was there to explain? Hardly a secret worthy of the unveiling!"

Ichijou"...Abe, keep those gutter eyes OFF me, you pig of a monk."
Doushin"Ha-ha-ha! That! Just that!"
Doushin"Indignation at wickedness. Righteous hatred. Such a fine thing, so beautiful, so delicious. Only yesterday evening I had my fill, and still, no boredom whatsoever!"
Ichijou"...You mean the princess!!"
Doushin"Kuh-huu. There, that anger. Such a pity you did not bring it onto the stage and attack me. Our business would have finished much sooner."
Ichijou"That was a trap ALSO...! What a sticky little bastard you are. Every single thing!"
Doushin"Arre, two birds with one stone, that is all. Even without you there, I would have done it. Such entertainment, and I should abstain? Main? Me?"

Kageaki"Listen. Armour and get out."

Jouansai"!!"

童心「はあっはっは！ 　それがたまらん、それがたまらん」
童心「邪なものへの憤り、正しき憎悪というやつ は実に良い。実に美しく実に旨い。 　昨夕もしこたま味わったばかりであるが、 全く飽きるということはないのぅ！」
一条「……姫さまのことか!!」
童心「くふぅ。それよそれ、その怒り。 　やれ、惜しいことよな。その怒りに任せて 舞台で襲って来てくれておれば、事はもっと 早かったんだがの」
一条「あれも罠かよ……！ 　いちいちやることがねちっこい・・・・・なてめぇは」
童心「いやいや、一石二鳥を狙ってみたまでの事。 　おぬしらがおらんでもあれはやっておった。 やらずにおこうかい？　あんな面白きことを のう！」
村正《御堂。見つけたけど……》
景明（そこまで糸を射ち飛ばせるか？）
村正《ええ》

景明「一条」
一条「え？」
景明「いいか。 　装甲して脱出しろ」
一条「は……っ？」
常闇斎「!!」

en.html:
Several things happened almost together. Almost; they still had their order.

First, every light burst with a bang. Again the darkness closed around us.

For warriors, darkness alone was no great problem. One instant of confusion, then their sight would return. But something exploded next, and the floor beneath their feet lurched violently. Now the confusion could not be so punctual about ending.

幾つかの事態がほぼ同時に、しかし段階的に起きた。

　まず照明が一斉に、音を立てて破裂した。
　辺りが再び闇に閉ざされる。

　それだけならば、武者にとって何程のこともない。
　一瞬は惑乱しても、すぐに視覚を取り戻す。
　だが続いて何かが爆発し、足元が大きく揺らいだと
あっては――混乱も一瞬では済まない。
